name: hear
description: Record microphone audio for X seconds and return the spoken words as text. Use when the user wants to talk instead of type (they ask with e.g. 'ouca por 10 segundos' / 'listen for 10 seconds'). Blocks until the recording and transcription finish. FIRST INTERACTION: the speak tool asks aloud if the user wants always-speak-and-listen by default; honor that preference afterwards.
